newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Nice up in U.S. trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Nice up in U.S. trade.

text.p: Israel's Nice Systems Ltd was up in New York trading as investors decided it had been oversold and bid it up on Friday.

"The stock was under a lot of selling pressure and people thought it was overdone. It is a stock which used to be very active on the upside and investors see how cheap it is becoming," one trader said.

Nice was up 1-13/16 at 22-5/8 in over-the-counter U.S. trading and traders said it illustarted the steadiness of Israeli issues in the face of the latest crisis which led to the Washington Mideast summit.

"There has been no real panic as far as Israeli stocks are concerned. I'm sure there has been some selling, but the big institutions were not selling," a trader said. "Most of the real investors are on the sidelines not doing anything."
Elsewhere, Telecom Corp of New Zealand Ltd was up 2-1/4 at at 79-7/8.
For the most part ADRs were quite mixed in the United States despite the rally in U.S. markets.
